faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The things people ask before they build.
faq.q.hosting.q: Do I need my own server?
faq.q.hosting.a: No. We own and run the infrastructure. There is no VPS, Docker or webhook to configure.
faq.q.token.q: Do I need to understand bot tokens?
faq.q.token.a: No. Either we assign a ready-made bot instantly, or we walk you through a one-minute setup and take over from there.
faq.q.platforms.q: Can I have Telegram and Bale?
faq.q.platforms.a: Yes, and they share one configuration and one database, so you enter your business details once.
faq.q.changeLater.a: Yes. Features are modular and can be added to a running bot.
faq.q.payment.a: Card transfer for Iranian customers, or cryptocurrency internationally. You upload proof and we verify it.
faq.q.howLong.a: Once payment is approved, provisioning is automatic and usually takes minutes.
